the JKR analysis is not applicable to nanoindentation performed with the AFM.

, for soft materials, the JKR model can be used to calculate the modulus of the material during loading, but the modulus of the sample during unloading is not well described by the JKR model.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the JKR adhesion model is not suitable for analysis of AFM-based nanoindentation experiments.
the JKR theory does not provide the correct description of the unloading portion of the indentation data collected using the AFM.
